jobDescription:
Own the delivery of Plus500's public website: regulated, multilingual (LTR/RTL), dark-mode and accessible, serving [X] locales. I work across C#/Razor (ASP.NET MVC), SCSS and vanilla JS, which saves other teams time and resources.

  • Performance: led a multi-step overhaul of the high-traffic Instrument pages (lazy loading, caching, preload hints, prebuilt view models) and added Lighthouse CI. Result: [Lighthouse / load-time improvement].
  • Reusable components: built the MarketingComponents widgets (instruments table, Prediction Markets events and popups, dark mode, postMessage API) that are embedded across the Main, Futures and Japan sites.
  • Analytics: migrated Universal Analytics to GA4, enriched events, and cleaned up the GTM data layer and click reporting to BigQuery.
  • Tooling: moved the front-end build from Gulp to Vite and fixed the local development flow (CORS, dev builds).
  • Design system: aligned the sites to the new layout and WDS (glossary and corporate-account pages) and built localized RTL/Arabic experiences.
  • SEO: structured data (JSON-LD), Google Preferred Sources, and optimization of the homepage and instrument pages.
  • Team and AI tooling: wrote GitHub Copilot review instructions for the landing-page repos and presented them. I also made short clips documenting the domain projects.
  • Also: email builder, affiliates website, Cloudflare landing pages and investor-relations pages.

I've been in charge of WordPress websites (installations, maintenance, optimization, customization to both frontend & backend), Lead the development of an interactive accessibility tool for people with disabilities. Helped with building of web applications & worked with various API's, took part in creating ERP interfaces. Optimized websites with the recommendations of google PAGE INSIGHTS (such as: caching, minification, content delivery).

Learned AngularJS, gained more PHP & MYSQL experience. Started working with GIT & AWS services (EC2, S3).

Created a unique accessibility tool for the company which covered 65% of WCAG AA requirements. I was in charge of website innovation, required research on my part in UX / UI. Helped implementing methods for Google Analytics Events, later on with Google's Tag Manager. Implemented several jQuery galleries & plugins, also wrote some of my own. Customized the "Bsmart" application backend system for the client needs.

Learned working with Bootstrap, perfected JavaScript & jQuery Skills. Mainly worked with XSLT, HTML5, ASP, CSS, JavaScript & jQuery.
Installed, maintained and customized Drupal, Joomla and WordPress sites. Built static HTML/CSS websites and landing pages. Worked with cPanel, Control Web Panel, Plesk and DirectAdmin.
